name: Freebuff AI Coding Agent
free_limit: Ad-supported Free coding agent for desktop, CLI and web, with unlimited messages per hour-long session and daily hours that reset at local midnight. Official November 7 guide says 5 hours/day in countries outside listed full-access regions (4 via VPN); country, model multipliers and account eligibility affect effective hours.
watch_out: Homepage says unlimited, but free usage is daily-hour-limited and model-dependent; /plans advertises full-access figures that do not apply globally. Free access requires a human present, one account per person, and may require phone or identity verification. No direct API, scripted/bot use, resale or account sharing; terms and quotas may change. Ad-supported; code and prompts are processed by the service/model providers. Cloud inference is included, not a self-hosted free inference service.
